name: nova
description: Nova by Compass AI - a fully-fledged software engineer at your command
run: npx -y @compass-ai/nova@1.1.43 models register --name probe --api openai --base-url ${MOCK_LLM_URL} --api-key probe-mock-key --model probe-model --default ; npx -y @compass-ai/nova@1.1.43 acp
notes: Attempted wiring: `nova models register` (documented custom-endpoint command) registers an OpenAI provider against the mock LLM; flag names inferred — CI transcript will show if the CLI differs. HOME=${WORK_DIR} confines ~/.nova state.
